Class MetaData

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.MetaData
public class MetaData extends Object
A table for storing meta information about a story graph. Every piece of meta-data has a string key. Values can be of several types, including strings, numbers, and timestamps.

One common piece of meta-data stored in this table is the number of elements of various kinds of the story graph (for example, the number of character symbols). By storing this information, a graph can allocate collections of exactly the right size before reading a potentially large number of elements from file.

Author:
Stephen G. Ware

      public MetaData()
      Constructs a new meta-data table. The VERSION key will be set to Settings.VERSION_STRING, and the CREATED and MODIFIED keys will be set to Instant.now().
